title: tsuga mertensiana subsp. jeffreyi
intro: Tsuga mertensiana subsp. jeffreyi, commonly known as mountain hemlock or western hemlock, is a subspecies of evergreen coniferous tree in the family Pinaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tsuga mertensiana subsp. jeffreyi include antiseptic, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating wounds, pain, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
